validity.recommendation: keep as cancelled; no action beyond the fills/status_reviews below
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE CONFIRMED, independent of GEM/wiki. The sheet's own cited abarrelfull link (bit.ly/2sl9gSY) resolves to the banned abarrelfull.wikidot.com and is unusable (standing rule 5) -- but the project is well documented in contemporaneous trade and local press. Natural Gas Intelligence ran two 2012 pieces (naturalgasintel.com/news/2b-worth-of-pipeline-projects-target-marcellus-gas/, 2012-03-05; naturalgasintel.com/news/trio-seeks-shippers-for-commonwealth-pipeline/, 2012-05-08) describing a joint open season by Inergy Midstream LP, UGI Energy Services Inc. and Capitol Energy Ventures Corp. (a WGL Holdings unit) for a proposed 200-mile, 30-inch pipeline carrying up to 1.2 Bcf/d from the southern terminus of Inergy's MARC I pipeline in Lycoming County, PA to the Dominion Cove Point LNG LP pipeline in Charles County, MD -- an exact match to the sheet's StartLocation/EndLocation/Capacity. WHYY (2013-04-18) and NBC10 Philadelphia (2013-04-18, AP-credited) independently reported the same-day announcement that the sponsors suspended the project 'indefinitely' with no reason given, confirming the pipeline was a genuine, three-way-backed proposal (Inergy Midstream LP / UGI Energy Services Inc. / WGL Holdings Inc.), not a GEM-only entity. NBC10 additionally corroborates the 30-inch diameter independently of NGI. No FERC pre-filing docket was found for the project (searched elibrary.ferc.gov and general search for 'Commonwealth Pipeline' + FERC/PF12) -- consistent with a project that never advanced past the open-season stage before being suspended, not an existence red flag. Classification (gas transmission) is correct; no duplicate found against the 45-row US-gas roster. GEM's dead dailylocal.com citation (the article behind the sheet's origin) is confirmed 404 -- genuinely gone, correctly not restorable, but WHYY/NBC10 report the identical April 2013 event and are cited in its place.

validity.recommendation: correct ShelvedYear from 2015 to 2013 -- the sourced suspension date
validity.researcher_notes: The sheet's ShelvedYear=2015 does not match any evidence found. The only dated dormancy event is the sponsors' suspension announcement reported by WHYY and NBC10 on 2013-04-18 (both citing the same-day posting on the sponsors' own commonwealthpipeline.com). No news, filing, or corporate disclosure places any project activity or status change in 2015 -- that appears to be an artifact of the originally-targeted 2015 in-service date (NGI: 'service would begin in 2015') being mistaken for a shelving date. Recommend ShelvedYear=2013. Note this does not disturb CancelledYear=2017: under the sweep's own dormancy rule (shelved >=4y -> cancelled), 2013+4=2017, so the sheet's existing CancelledYear is actually consistent with the CORRECTED ShelvedYear even though it was evidently computed off the wrong shelving year -- see the Cancelled [ref] fill and the status_reviews entry below. ShelvedCancelledType stays 'inferred': I found a dated SUSPENSION notice, not a dated CANCELLATION notice (no FERC withdrawal, no sponsor announcement of formal termination), so 'cancelled' remains an inference from 13 years of silence, not a confirmed event.

The pipeline never entered service. NGI (2012-05-08) states the sponsors targeted a 2015 in-service date, but that is a pre-suspension TARGET, not an actual commercial-operation date, and populating StartYear1 with it would misrepresent a cancelled project as having started. Leaving blank.

fills.researcher_notes: Exact numeric match ('up to 1.2 Bcf/d' = 1200 MMcf/d). Single publisher (NGI) states the design-capacity figure precisely; a companion NGI piece (2012-03-05) separately states 'at least 800,000 Dth/d' as the minimum anchor-shipper commitment -- a different, smaller, non-conflicting figure (floor vs. design ceiling), not corroboration of 1200. Searched WGL Holdings/Crestwood press releases and FERC for a second independent capacity figure; none found (project never reached a FERC filing where capacity would be re-stated).

No MAOP/operating-pressure figure exists in any source found -- expected, since the project never filed a FERC certificate application (where such design specs are typically disclosed) before being suspended in 2013.

fills.researcher_notes: NGI is the only source that states the full route including the Maryland (Charles County) terminus explicitly; WHYY and NBC10 independently confirm the Lycoming County, PA start and the general southbound direction toward Philadelphia/Baltimore/DC/Delmarva, but their own reporting only traces the route 'to Chester County' (their own geographic focus, both papers being PA/Philadelphia outlets) and does not itself name Charles County or Maryland as the terminus. So the PA start point has 2 independent confirmations; the MD end point has one strong, highly specific one (naming the exact interconnect). Searched FERC (no docket -- project never filed) and PADEP's pipeline portal (no Commonwealth Pipeline entry) for a second source naming the Maryland terminus; none found.

No cost estimate found in any source. The project stayed at the non-binding open-season stage (rates 'will be determined after the conclusion of the open season') and never reached a FERC certificate filing, where a cost estimate would normally be disclosed. Searched NGI, WGL Holdings/Crestwood coverage, SEC EDGAR (WGL Holdings 10-Ks) -- no dollar figure for Commonwealth Pipeline specifically.

No source names a single operator. All coverage describes Inergy Midstream LP, UGI Energy Services Inc. and Capitol Energy Ventures Corp. as co-equal sponsors of a proposed joint-venture pipeline with 'equal equity interests'; none designates one of the three as the operating partner (unsurprising -- the project never reached the stage of forming an operating entity before being suspended in 2013).

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status itself (cancelled) is right and stays. The dated evidence (two independent 2013-04-18 reports of the sponsors' indefinite suspension) supports ShelvedYear=2013, not the sheet's current 2015 -- see the spec concern in validity[]. No news, FERC action, or corporate disclosure of any kind was found after April 2013 through today (2026-09), a 13-year silence -- comfortably past the sweep's 4-year shelved->cancelled dormancy threshold measured from the corrected 2013 date, so 'cancelled' is well supported as an inference. summary: P0170 Commonwealth Gas Pipeline is a real, well-documented 2012 proposal (Inergy Midstream/UGI/WGL, Lycoming Co PA -> Charles Co MD, 200mi/30in/1200 MMcf/d, all confirmed) suspended in April 2013 and correctly cancelled today; staged REFS_ADDED on 10 units (Status, Fuel, Proposal, Shelved-corrected-to-2013, Capacity, Length, Diameter, FuelSource, Location, Owner-entity-corrected) plus 1 spec concern (ShelvedYear 2015->2013) and 1 attribution concern (owner entity precision); Construction/Start/Pressure/SegmentCost/Operator/Cancelled-year genuinely UNRESOLVED (project never reached construction or a FERC filing).
